risk_scoring.description: risk = sum over triggered rules of (base_points[rule.severity] + min(excess_ratio, overage_cap_ratio) * max_overage_bonus), capped at 100. excess_ratio = (observed - threshold) / threshold. Computed from raw telemetry only; never reads a pre-labeled score column.

rules.description: Main compression force exceeds demonstration threshold; normal band observed up to ~19.0 kN.
Estimated tablet weight deviates from the 500 mg target by more than the demonstration tolerance.
Elevated ejection force is a telemetry proxy only; never sufficient alone to confirm sticking/picking.
Vibration RMS exceeds demonstration threshold; normal band observed up to ~1.47 mm/s.
Corroborating bearing temperature rise alongside elevated vibration.
